newsitem.title: UK: Sterling soars in Europe, boosted by UK jobs data.
newsitem.headline: Sterling soars in Europe, boosted by UK jobs data.

text.p: Sterling rocketed over two pfennigs and rose half a cent from early lows after a bigger than expected fall in jobless figures but analysts said mild earnings data should cap the rally.
"Average earnings figures are a welcome surprise, although the fall in unemployment is a little higher than we were looking for," said Peter Osler, analyst at GNI.

UK April unemployment fell by 59,400 against forecasts for a 40,000 drop and a revised 37,300 drop in March. Average earnings data, however, was softer with March underlying earnings up 4.5 percent against a 5.0 percent forecast.
